turns.prompt: Fit the nonlinear model pi = 3.141592653589793238462643383279E0 y = b1 - b2*x - arctan[b3/(x-b4)]/pi to the data in roszman1.csv (columns x, y) by least squares, starting from b1 = 0.1, b2 = -0.00001, b3 = 1000, b4 = -100. Report every parameter (b1, b2, b3, b4) to at least 6 significant digits and the residual sum of squares as rss.

provenance: NIST StRD Roszman1 (public domain), data copied verbatim
